The '''Rangehunter EE-1 carbine rifle''' was a type of [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[war against Zakuul]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] would use these blaster rifles against the [[Skytrooper]]s on [[Darvannis]].
